topic: SAP ECC self-test Q&A (used to measure and grow confidence)

qa.q: What T-code is used to view or display a customer centrally in SAP ECC?
qa.a: XD03 — Display Customer (Centrally). It is the read-only mirror of XD01.

qa.q: What T-code creates a customer centrally?
qa.a: XD01 — Create Customer (Centrally), covering General, Company Code and Sales Area views.

qa.q: What is the Sales Area in SD?
qa.a: A Sales Area is the combination of Sales Organization + Distribution Channel + Division.

qa.q: Which table stores customer general data?
qa.a: KNA1 stores customer master general data; KNB1 company-code data; KNVV sales-area data; KNVP partner functions.
The smallest organisational unit in FI for which a complete set of legal financial statements can be drawn up (example in scope: 2100).
Customer master → Sales Order (VA01) → Delivery (VL01N) → Goods Issue → Billing (VF01) → AR posting → Incoming Payment (F-28).
Material & Vendor master → Purchase Order (ME21N) → Goods Receipt (MIGO) → Invoice Verification (MIRO) → Outgoing Payment (F-53).

qa.q: What is the successor of SAP ECC?
qa.a: SAP S/4HANA, which runs on the HANA in-memory database and uses the Business Partner (BP) for customers and vendors.
A G/L account that links a sub-ledger (e.g. customer AR) to the general ledger; in scope it is fixed at 11000000.

qa.q: What are the standard partner functions in SD?
qa.a: AG = Sold-to party, WE = Ship-to party, RE = Bill-to party, RG = Payer.

qa.q: What is the difference between master data and transaction data?
qa.a: Master data is long-living reference data (customer, vendor, material) reused across documents; transaction data is the business documents (orders, deliveries, invoices) that reference it.
